message: If you'd like to support us, please share a link to this website on your social media, forums, blogs, etc. It will be much appreciated.
You can upload up to 10 subtitles at once for subpicture conversion when ads are allowed. Simply press SHIFT/CTRL key when selecting the files for upload.

We've added experimental support for converting text-based subtitles to PGS (.sup). Furthermore, we've significantly improved subpicture conversion performance in Chrome. Give it a try and let us know if you hit any issues!
